name: RTI Application
description: Use this to ask a government office for information under Section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005, such as the status of your application, pension or any official record.

fields.name: information
fields.label: Information you need (one point per line)

fields.name: fee_details
fields.label: Fee payment details (e.g. IPO number / online receipt)

name: Consumer Complaint Letter to Seller
description: A first written complaint to a seller or service provider about a defective product or poor service, asking for a refund, replacement or repair. Sending this is usually the first step before approaching the Consumer Helpline or Commission.

fields.name: order_details
fields.label: Order / invoice number and date of purchase

name: Notice for Refund of Security Deposit
description: A written notice from a tenant to a landlord asking for the security deposit to be returned after vacating the premises.

fields.name: vacated_on
fields.label: Date you vacated and handed over keys

name: Rental Agreement (11 months)
description: A simple residential leave-and-licence style rent agreement for 11 months. Print it on stamp paper of the value required in your state and have it signed by both parties and two witnesses.
content:
RENTAL AGREEMENT

This Rental Agreement is made at {{place}} on {{date}} between:

{{landlord_name}}, residing at {{landlord_address}} (hereinafter called the LANDLORD), and

{{tenant_name}}, residing at {{tenant_address}} (hereinafter called the TENANT).

1. Property: The Landlord lets the residential premises at {{property_address}} to the Tenant.
2. Term: The tenancy is for 11 months starting from {{start_date}}, and may be renewed by mutual consent.
3. Rent: The Tenant shall pay a monthly rent of Rs. {{rent}} on or before the 5th day of every month.
4. Security deposit: The Tenant has paid a refundable, interest-free security deposit of Rs. {{deposit}}, to be refunded when the Tenant vacates, after deducting any unpaid dues or cost of damage beyond normal wear and tear.
5. Utilities: Electricity, water and similar charges for actual use shall be paid by the Tenant.
6. Use: The premises shall be used only for residential purposes and shall not be sub-let.
7. Maintenance: The Tenant shall keep the premises in good condition. Major structural repairs are the Landlord's responsibility.
8. Termination: Either party may end this agreement by giving {{notice_period}} month(s) written notice.
9. Handover: On termination, the Tenant shall hand over vacant possession of the premises in good condition.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have signed this agreement on the date mentioned above.

LANDLORD: ____________________ ({{landlord_name}})

TENANT: ____________________ ({{tenant_name}})

WITNESSES:
1. ____________________
2. ____________________

name: Written Complaint to Police (FIR request)
description: A written complaint to the Station House Officer describing an offence and requesting registration of an FIR. Keep a stamped acknowledgement copy.

name: Complaint to Bank about Unauthorised Transaction
description: A letter to your bank reporting an unauthorised UPI, card or net-banking transaction and asking for the amount to be reversed. Send it as soon as possible after the fraud.

fields.name: transaction_details
fields.label: Transaction date, amount and reference ID(s)

fields.name: cyber_complaint
fields.label: Cyber crime complaint / 1930 acknowledgement number (if any)

name: General Affidavit
description: A simple sworn statement of facts, often needed for name corrections, address proof or lost documents. It must be printed on stamp paper and signed before a Notary or Oath Commissioner.

fields.name: statements
fields.label: Facts you are declaring (one per line)

content:
AFFIDAVIT

I, {{deponent_name}}, son/daughter/wife of {{relation}}, aged {{age}} years, residing at {{address}}, do hereby solemnly affirm and declare as under:

{{statements}}

VERIFICATION

Verified at {{place}} on {{date}} that the contents of the above affidavit are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief, and nothing material has been concealed.

DEPONENT

____________________
({{deponent_name}})
